mother_image_source: 本轮 mono-color-skill 生成的原创海报；作为这一成对案例的实际输入。
mother_image_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: original flat editorial print, portrait 3:4. This is a newly invented practice artwork, no real brand or event. Create a contemporary two-ink editorial poster on clean neutral-white paper #FAFAF7. Exactly two printing plates: cobalt #2148B8 carries the moka-pot image, main words and structure (about 80% of printed area); terracotta #C65F38 is reserved for one hot steam ribbon and its short underline (about 20%). Tonal dots and overlap are densities of these plates, no other colored ink. Flat front-facing paper, no mockup.

An asymmetrical editorial-cover composition with one giant moka pot, closely cropped along the lower and right edges, taking about 65% of page. The octagonal body, angular lid and handle are immediately recognizable. One concentrated focal event: the giant geometric pot interrupted by a bold word across its midsection. Leave a very quiet open upper-left paper zone and roughly 35% unprinted paper. Seven-percent outer margins. Do not safely split text on one side and a complete object on the other.

Reproduce the pot as a sharply cut screened cobalt image with visible medium halftone dots and paper knocking through its highlights. A single terracotta steam ribbon curves once upward, not multiple curls or doodles. No coffee cup, beans, plant or decorative props. All meaning comes from one familiar object and the relationship between steam and type.

Set exact text 'slow mornings' in large characterful lowercase editorial serif, tightly locked to and partially crossing the pot, fully readable. Only one tiny neutral grotesk support line, exact text 'COFFEE AT HOME'. At least an eight-to-one scale jump. No other writing, numbers, brands, logos or dates. Keep the phrase unchanged.

Clean contemporary print, not nostalgic or aged: subtle ink-density variation and dry-ink edges only. No sepia, stained paper, frames, cast shadows, gradients, glossy depth, digital monochrome wash, marketing slogan, QR code or watermark. Make the final output an original raster editorial artwork with convincing physical two-plate reproduction.
application:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: photorealistic real-world application of the supplied original artwork, portrait 3:4. The image is a fictional practice mockup, not a real commissioned or manufactured product. Image 1 is the exact artwork reference. Preserve the same giant faceted cobalt moka pot, terracotta steam ribbon, exact words 'slow mornings' and 'COFFEE AT HOME', word placement, serif letter shapes, and two printing-ink roles. Do not invent a new design or rewrite any word.

Show a large unbranded natural-white canvas shopping tote bag standing on a plain pale stone cafe counter in soft daylight, in a three-quarter view from slightly above. The bag fills about 80% of the frame; both handles and the cloth mouth are physically coherent and visible. The recognisable artwork is screen-printed directly over the full front fabric and naturally continues toward the right side gusset, NOT a flat rectangular sheet or pasted poster. The moka pot print and steam must visibly deform with broad fabric folds, the side turn, and a lower stitched seam; ink absorbs into woven cotton, cloth texture remains visible through the screened areas. Keep the main phrase on the broadly visible front so it remains completely legible. Let a gentle fold cross part of the pot and the word while keeping it readable. The physical surface must affect the art.

Use a restrained real cafe environment only as scale context: plain wall, small blurred counter edge, no people, no extra products, branding or signage. Soft contact shadow under the bag and believable canvas thickness. Scene colors may be neutral photographic colors, but printed artwork retains the supplied cobalt/terracotta, paper-white exposure, halftone character and identity. No additional writing, captions, sequence numbers, badges, logos, price, QR code, watermark or border. Produce a polished original product-application image.
